# Monster Lairs and Seals

## Function

Monster lairs are concentration points within the Constructed World. They keep landscapes, inhabitants, cities, or memories bound and provide the hero with clear local objectives.

The term “lair” describes a function rather than a fixed physical form. A monster source may also be:

- an underground structure;
- a ruin;
- a tower;
- a rift in space;
- a corrupted forest core;
- an artificial system chamber;
- a mobile monster structure.

## Completion Methods

Depending on the region, the hero may:

- cleanse the source;
- seal it;
- close it;
- destroy it;
- separate it from a bound soul;
- reprogram it for a new purpose.

## Connection to the Truth

Early monster lairs appear to be natural breeding grounds for evil. Later sources should reveal that they were deliberately placed, reused, or administered by a system. The content thereby prepares the revelation through gameplay.

## Minimum Content per Source

- a distinct visual motif;
- at least one unique mix of enemies;
- a local puzzle, obstacle, or navigation feature;
- a visible connection to the reconstruction it is holding in place;
- a concluding reaction within the world.
